D: A stunt pilot finds a jetpack and fights Nazi spies in 1938 Los Angeles.
P: Serve the mains when Cliff and Peevy eat at the Bulldog Cafe.
S: the diner shaped like a bulldog
Thick onion rings soaked in buttermilk, dipped in beer batter, fried at 185C until puffed.
Coconut prawns: prawns in flour, egg and coconut panko, fried at 180C, with pineapple salsa.
Chaplin Field egg and bacon rolls

Soft milk rolls stuffed with creamy egg salad, crisp bacon, chives and a pinch of paprika, wrapped in wax paper like a pilot's lunch. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and chop. Mix with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp mustard, 2 tbsp chives, salt and pepper. Grill 6 bacon rashers until crisp and crumble. Split 8 soft milk rolls, fill with egg salad, scatter with bacon and a pinch of paprika. Wrap each in wax paper and twist the ends.
M: Thick patty griddled to medium with melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato, pickles and a tangy special sauce on a toasted bun, double-fried chips alongside. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties and season. Griddle 4 minutes a side, add 2 slices cheddar each and cover 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Fry the chips at 190C for 3 minutes and salt. Toast 4 buns and build with sauce, lettuce, tomato, patty and pickles.
Jenny's big night out at the club
Chicken thighs marinated in pineapple juice, soy, ginger and garlic, grilled and glazed with the reduced marinade, coconut rice.
W: Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and a cherry, a sparkler lit at the table.
K: Bulldog Cafe root beer malt float
the counter at the Bulldog, after a good flight

Ice-cold root beer poured over vanilla ice cream in frosted mugs, with a spoon of malt powder stirred through for a creamy, foamy top. Put 4 mugs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream and 1 tsp malted milk powder to each. Slowly pour 250ml cold root beer down the side of each mug so the foam rises without spilling. Serve with long spoons and straws.

s.note: the diner shaped like a bulldog
s.how: Cut 3 onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C until puffed and golden. Salt and serve hot.

Dip 400g peeled green prawns in flour, beaten egg and a mix of 60g shredded coconut and 60g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Dice a quarter pineapple with red onion, chilli and lime for salsa. Serve together.

m.note: Jenny's big night out at the club
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 250ml pineapple juice, 60ml soy, grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves for 2 hours. Grill, then reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Cook 300g jasmine rice in 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water.

w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a cherry. Push a sparkler into each and light it at the table.
